title: Spider-Man: Brand New Day — Peter Starts Again

cover.alt: An original masked young city acrobat swings on a rope above warm city lights at night.

blocks.title: Introduction
paragraphs: The world forgets Peter Parker. His old friends move on. But Peter still puts on the mask. He is Spider-Man, and he chooses to keep going.

items.prompt: Do you know any Spider-Man stories? What do you remember?
items.answer: Open answer. For example: I know Spider-Man is a hero in New York. He can climb walls and shoot webs.
items.explanation: There are no wrong answers here. Just think about what you already know.

items.prompt: If people forgot who you were, how would you feel?
items.answer: Open answer. For example: I would feel sad and alone.
items.explanation: This helps you connect to Peter Parker's situation in the new movie.

items.prompt: What makes someone a hero? Think of one reason.
items.answer: Open answer. For example: A hero helps others even when it is hard.
items.explanation: Keep this idea in mind as you learn about Spider-Man's choices.

blocks.title: Part 1 — How Spider-Man Began
paragraphs: Spider-Man first appeared in Amazing Fantasy 15 in August 1962. Stan Lee wrote the stories and Steve Ditko drew them. In the story, a student named Peter Parker visits a science exhibit. A radioactive spider bites him. After the bite, Peter gains super powers. He invents web shooters. He puts on a costume and becomes Spider-Man.

items.prompt: Where did Peter Parker get his powers?
items.answer: A radioactive spider bit Peter Parker at a science exhibit. The bite gave him super powers.
items.explanation:
This happened in Amazing Fantasy 15, published in August 1962.

Why do you think Peter chose to become a hero after getting his powers?

blocks.title: Part 2 — The World Forgets Peter
paragraphs: In Spider-Man: Brand New Day, something big changes. The whole world forgets Peter Parker. His old friends do not remember him. They move on with their lives. Peter is alone. But he does not stop. He works as Spider-Man full-time. He still saves people. Even without anyone knowing his name, he keeps choosing to help.

items.prompt: What happens to Peter Parker at the start of Brand New Day?
items.answer: The whole world forgets Peter Parker. His old friends move on, and Peter is alone. He keeps working as Spider-Man full-time even though no one knows his name.
items.explanation:
This is the main situation of the new Sony Pictures movie.

Do you think it is hard to help people when no one knows who you are? Why?

blocks.title: Part 3 — A Change Starts in Peter
paragraphs: Seeing his old friends move on creates pressure for Peter. This starts a change in him. Peter may not be able to control that change. But that transformation may help stop a new threat to the city and the people he loves.

blocks.title: Check — A Change Starts in Peter

items.prompt: What is changing inside Peter Parker in Brand New Day?
items.answer: Seeing his old friends move on creates pressure and starts a change in Peter. He may not be able to control it, but that transformation may help stop a new threat.
items.explanation: This change is described in the official Sony Pictures story for Brand New Day.

blocks.title: Part 4 — A Villain Nobody Can See
paragraphs: Peter also faces a new threat. The villain in Brand New Day cannot be seen. This makes the danger very hard to face. A threat that cannot be seen is a serious danger to the city and the people Peter loves.

blocks.title: Check — A Villain Nobody Can See

items.prompt: What do we know about the villain in Brand New Day?
items.answer: The villain cannot be seen. This makes the villain a serious new threat to the city and the people Peter loves.
items.explanation:
This detail comes from the official Sony Pictures synopsis for Brand New Day.

Why do you think a villain who cannot be seen would be so dangerous?

blocks.title: Part 5 — The Movie: July 31, 2026
paragraphs: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is a Sony Pictures movie. It opens on July 31, 2026. The world does not remember Peter Parker. He works as Spider-Man full-time. He faces a villain no one can see. A change begins inside him that he may not be able to control. Peter still chooses to help the city and the people he loves.

items.prompt: When does Spider-Man: Brand New Day open, and who made it?
items.answer: Spider-Man: Brand New Day is a Sony Pictures movie. It opens on July 31, 2026.
items.explanation: This information comes from the official Sony Pictures page for the movie.

items.prompt: Peter Parker loses everything people know about him. But he still chooses to be Spider-Man. Do you think that is brave? What would you do?
items.answer: Sample answer: Yes, I think it is very brave. Peter has no fame and no support, but he still helps people. I think I would feel scared, but I hope I would keep going too, like Peter does.
items.explanation:
There is no single right answer. The important thing is to think about what courage means to you.

Which part of Peter's story — his origin, his loneliness, or his hidden enemy — surprised you most? Why?
